memoryMonitoringQualifications.qualification: A recorded maxSampleRSSKiB=0 means the1s sampler captured no live matching compiler; RSS is unavailable, not zero memory use. Peaks are sampled lower bounds, not OS high-water marks.
memoryMonitoringQualifications.compilerScope: main worktree only; lane2 separately classified

finalValidationContinuation.rulingVerbatim: R193 VALIDATION GATE RULING: APPROVED — ONE hash-pinned, append-only, identical-source LocalDiamond retry with a separately authenticated continuation manifest (original plan + V2 record never rewritten), then V3–V52 only after a fresh retry PASS. GUARD REVISION (supervisor resource ruling, record verbatim): for THIS unchanged-source LocalDiamond validation the RSS kill threshold is raised from 48 GiB to 52 GiB (54,525,952 KiB). Rationale: the source is byte-identical to the R192 PASS (sampled 47.52 GiB); 48.12 GiB is Chez GC variance, not a type or cost regression; the machine has 256 GiB and lane 2's heavy checks are serialized by the heavy lock, so 52 GiB is safe. The 48 GiB guard remains for every other check and for any CHANGED LocalDiamond source. Hold the heavy lock for the whole retry. If the retry exceeds 52 GiB, stop and gate with the honest partial final validation (no third attempt). Record the 48.12 GiB stop, the ruling, and the retry's sampled peak in the ledger/audit.

rawPassMeaning: passedCount preserves the runner outcome; qualifiedPassedCount excludes explicitly invalidated validation invocations without rewriting their exact records.
matchingSourceCommitsMeaning: Baseline plus target-changing commits in (start,end], matched by SHA256; validation repeats can match the same source commit. Empty for rejected/uncommitted sources.
packageFreshMeaning: Inherited runner marks package fresh on successful seeded --build (no forced source rebuild); source checks require target Building line.
